licenceStages.note: Section 14 & 15 MV Act: renewal allowed within 1 yr before or after expiry; test after 1 yr. The 30-day grace is assumed for the late-fee start only; driving on an expired licence is NOT assumed lawful (s.181) until an official source says otherwise.

reRegistrationLimitDays.note: Section 47 MV Act: 12 months statutory limit before assignment of new registration mark in another state.

rcAddressIntimationDays.note: Section 49 MV Act: intimation of change of residence within 30 days to the registering authority.

servicesOnline.note: Aadhaar contactless online faceless services available via Sarathi and Vahan.

licenceRenewalAtAnyRTO.note: Section 15 MV Act: renewal can be granted by any licensing authority or online.

nocAddressMustMatchRC.note: modelled rule (assumed): parent state RTO verifies owner identity against existing registration records before issuing NOC.

fees.label: Driving Licence Renewal
fees.note: CMVR Rule 81 Item 9: statutory renewal application fee.

fees.label: Form 7 Smart Card Fee (per transaction)
fees.note: CMVR Rule 81 Item 11: smart card driving licence specification fee; applies per card issuance.

fees.label: Late Licence Renewal Penalty
fees.note: CMVR Rule 81: ₹300 late fee plus ₹1,000 for each additional year.

fees.label: Driving Licence Address Change
fees.note: CMVR Rule 81: amendment of licence record.

fees.label: No Objection Certificate (Form 28)
fees.note: No Form 28 fee appears on the state-department fee page read 24 Oct 2026 (only a 300 per month late charge for motorcycles). Not listed is not the same as nil: unconfirmed until the official schedule is read.

fees.label: New Registration Mark — Motor Cycle (Form 27)
fees.note: CMVR Rule 81 Item 4(a): assignment of new registration mark for motorcycle.

fees.label: New Registration Mark — Light Motor Vehicle (Form 27)
fees.note: CMVR Rule 81 Item 4(b): assignment of new registration mark for light motor vehicle.

fees.label: Hypothecation Endorsement
fees.note: CMVR Rule 81 Item 12: endorsement of hire purchase / lease / hypothecation.

fees.label: Hypothecation Termination (Form 35)
fees.note: State-department fee page read 24 Oct 2026 shows No Fee for termination (rule 61(1)); confirm against the official CMVR Rule 81 table before setting 0 and tagging Official.

fees.label: Destination State Lifetime Road Tax
fees.note: Calculated by destination state RTO based on original vehicle invoice value and age.

fees.label: Postal & Dispatch Charges
fees.note: Departmental speed post handling fees for smart card dispatch.

fees.label: Financier / Bank NOC Processing Fee
fees.note: Commercial bank documentation charges for issuing Form 28 loan consent.

fees.label: UIDAI Aadhaar Address Update
fees.note: UIDAI demographic update fee (administered by UIDAI, not transport department).
